items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled theorem `thm:contr-hae` at source lines 265-267: if f is a half adjoint equivalence then every fiber of f is contractible. The author's proof (source lines 268-281) is an explicit contraction: it unpacks the four components of ishae(f) and names (g y, epsilon y) as the centre (lines 269-270), then reduces the comparison with an arbitrary fiber element to a path in the source via the retained characterisation of paths in a fiber (lines 271-272), and defines gamma := opp(g p) `ct` eta x so that the required identity ap f gamma `ct` p = epsilon y holds by a three-step computation in which tau x is used for the middle step and naturality of epsilon for the last one (lines 273-280). The statement records only the contractibility, not the choice of centre or the explicit path that realizes it.
